profileSelectSubtitle: Select a starter pack. You can always change modules later.
profileError: Failed to apply profile. Please try again.
forbiddenTitle: Only an administrator can set this up
forbiddenBody: Your account is not an administrator of this organization, so it cannot choose a workspace mode. Ask an administrator to finish the setup, then sign in again.
currencyHint: Applies to the whole organization. You can change it later in settings.
countryHint: Sets the standard tax rate and partner rules for your documents. You can change it later in settings.
countryPresetLabel: Use the document names and numbering usual in {{country}}
countryPresetHint: Receipts, dispatches and their numbers follow local practice. Value tracking stays as your setup has it. You can change this later in the document profile settings.
organizationNameHint: What invitations, emails and printed documents call your organization. You can change it later in settings.
moduleChoiceSubtitle: Untick what you do not need, tick what you do. Nothing here is permanent.
moduleChoiceFooter: Inventory, locations and categories are always on. Everything else can be changed later in Settings → Modules.
singleModuleDescription: One module is the whole app — Production, if you make things. Everything else steps back; leave it any time in Settings → My modules.
focusChoiceSubtitle: Only modules that can stand on their own are listed. Nothing here is permanent.
